description: Use before writing or fixing pikchr diagrams for render_diagram (format pikchr): statement separators, label naming, string and colour syntax, error meanings, worked examples, identifier rule.
identifier: Name objects with the identifier as the capitalised label and the display name as the string: `N0002: box "engine"` then `arrow from N0002.e to N0003.w`. Labels must start with an uppercase letter and may not contain `.` or `-` (use `_`). Never invent identifiers.

examples.name: named objects and labelled arrow
examples.source:
Src: box "Source"
Dst: box "Sink" at 2 right of Src
arrow from Src.e to Dst.w "data" above

examples.name: shapes and fill colours
examples.source:
oval "Start" fill lightblue
arrow
box "Work" rad 10px fill 0xffeeaa
arrow
cylinder "DB"
arrow
diamond "Done?"

examples.name: direction change and bidirectional arrow
examples.source:
down
A1: box "Top"
arrow <-> down 1
A2: box "Bottom" dashed

examples.name: group in brackets
examples.source:
G1: [ box "in"; arrow; box "out" ]
arrow from G1.e right 0.5
circle "end"
